replay.input: enemy-hit: stationary, no firing; original natural enemies/projectiles
replay.mode: existing controlled level entry, original event engine and indexed drawing
replay.time_basis: sum of actual configured original frameCountMax * PIT delayPeriod for each simulated logic tick; excludes debug pause and video playback FPS
replay.reentry: Fresh original initialization plus deterministic replay from tick0; no pointer jump, snapshots or artificial spawned enemy scene

coverage.kind: Original ordered draw references whose rect intersects original playfield; later occlusion may cover them
limitations: One observed level/input/seed/mode only, not static full coverage for other routes, firing, RNG or difficulty
Enemy IDs normalize original quad base; tile_IDs retain actual quadrants; sheet namespace prevents collisions
Terrain layers and player/projectile/effect sprite2 references recorded; UI fonts, procedural particles and menu assets excluded
Last index window may be partial; playback may continue beyond recorded coverage but later materials are not indexed
Replacement status is frozen at build; regenerate or inspect current pack after editing external assets
